blurb: This is the least glamorous ਸੇਵਾ in the Institute and the most immediately useful. Every gurdwara with a room of donated laptops, every Khalsa school running a cart of iPads, every ਸੰਗਤ office with an inbox that stopped working needs someone who can fix it — and the credentials at the end of this path are the ones employers filter on before a human reads your name. Free training, from the vendors themselves.
